name: Food Products
description: Agricultural and processed foodstuffs for human consumption. Bulk staples, preserved rations, and nutritional products.

name: Pharmaceuticals
description: Standardized medicines and pharmaceutical products traded between worlds. Compact, high-value medical cargo.

name: Consumer Goods
description: Ordinary manufactured goods for civilian consumption. Everyday products of an industrial consumer economy.

name: Data
description: Commercially valuable information on physical storage media. Occupies cargo capacity despite representing vast quantities of data.

name: Entertainment
description: Cultural and entertainment products distributed between worlds. Distinct from raw data — the product is the experience itself.

name: Industrial Components
description: Manufactured components and equipment for industrial production and infrastructure. Hardware for maintenance, repair, and expansion.

name: Chemicals
description: Commodity chemical products used as industrial, agricultural, and production inputs. Broad category without per-substance simulation.

name: Advanced Raw Materials
description: Specialized raw and advanced physical materials for high-value industrial production. Distinct from ordinary chemicals and components.

name: Luxury Goods
description: High-value discretionary goods for affluent populations. Sensitive to wealth and market demand differences between worlds.

name: Military Goods
description: Equipment and supplies for military, security, and defense applications. Broad category without individual weapons simulation.

name: Compute Cores
description: Specialized computational hardware. Compact, high-value industrial goods distinct from data cargo — the processors, not the information.
